note: The book's pictures. Our own (renders, the owner's drawings, placeholders) have license own; every other picture needs a credit, an open licence, its URL, a source and a sha256 of the file as shipped (engine/book/media.js checkMedia). Shipped pictures are at most 1024 px on the long side, with a thumbnail of about 320 px; modifications says what was done to each, and for the new ones the sha256 of the original download.
